title: Design System: FTP y TFTP a corazón abierto

line.note: Translucent token; the ramp is built from its opaque base.

line-strong.note: Translucent token; the ramp is built from its opaque base.

lane.note: Translucent token; the ramp is built from its opaque base.

hover.note: Translucent token; the ramp is built from its opaque base.

wb-line.note: Translucent token; the ramp is built from its opaque base.

wb-line-strong.note: Translucent token; the ramp is built from its opaque base.

wb-lane.note: Translucent token; the ramp is built from its opaque base.

wb-hover.note: Translucent token; the ramp is built from its opaque base.

display.purpose: Product title in the top bar (19px at 1500px and below).

lesson.purpose: Operation titles written on the board and underlined in chalk; the largest type on screen.

lane-head.purpose: Names of the three lifelines in the sticky lane heads.

wire-note.purpose: The teacher's notes under each packet and the measured-silence label.

hand-note.purpose: Inspector explanation card and empty state.

wire-label.purpose: The packet on its arrow, in the role colour.

wire-meta.purpose: Timestamps, TCP detail lines, operation end marks and the hex dump.

figure.purpose: Statistics on the ledge and the inspector packet title.

caption-mono.purpose: Chips, tab ports, command mnemonics and badges.

inspector.purpose: Inspector field rows: sans names, mono values.

control.purpose: Buttons at 600; selects, hints and the client log at 400.

caption.purpose: Stat labels, role captions, status pills (600).

shadows.name: brand-mark-frame
shadows.purpose: Frame of the miniature board in the top bar.

shadows.name: segment-ring
shadows.purpose: Active segment of the mode switch.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focused input or select, beside its chalk border.

shadows.name: selected-packet
shadows.purpose: Selected packet row, with a 10% role-colour wash.

shadows.name: marked-field
shadows.purpose: Inspector field holding the plaintext password.

shadows.name: eraser
shadows.purpose: filter on the physical eraser crossing the board.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Chalk draw, step bar and toast entry.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Eraser sweep and the matching erase clip.

motion.name: chalk-draw
motion.value: 0.42s var(--ease-out) clip-path polygon from the sender edge to the receiver edge, padded 14px
motion.purpose: Signature: a live packet chalked from sender to receiver (chalk-out / chalk-in).

motion.name: chalk-appear
motion.purpose: Label, detail line and note arrive after the stroke.

motion.name: draw-lifetime
motion.purpose: Timer that removes the draw class, so hidden tabs never replay a backlog.

motion.name: eraser-sweep
motion.purpose: Signature: Limpiar sweeps the eraser across the board.

motion.name: erase
motion.purpose: Timeline content clips under the felt; lifelines stay. Board resets at 650ms.

motion.name: slide-up
motion.purpose: Step-mode bar and toast entry; transform only.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, background, border and box-shadow changes on controls and rows.

motion.name: packet-pacing
motion.purpose: Spacing between packets at Rápida, Normal and Lenta; step mode waits for the arrow key.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animations and transitions off; Limpiar clears instantly.

breakpoints.name: projector-row
breakpoints.purpose: Top bar compresses to one row: subtitle and speed label hide, title 19px.

breakpoints.name: stacked
breakpoints.purpose: Page scrolls; two columns (280px + board) with the inspector full-width below.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Single column, board 80vh, key hint hidden, lane heads drop addresses.

assets.name: chalk-stroke.svg
assets.purpose: 160px stroke tile repeated along every chalk line.

assets.name: chalk-dash.svg
assets.purpose: Broken stroke for ERROR, retransmission and dashed legend swatches.

assets.name: chalk-head.svg
assets.purpose: Double-pass chevron arrowhead at the receiver.

assets.name: chalk-dot.svg
assets.purpose: Irregular touch-down dot at the sender.

assets.name: chalk-circle.svg
assets.purpose: Open hand-drawn circle around the plaintext password.

assets.name: eraser.svg
assets.purpose: The eraser that sweeps the board on Limpiar.

assets.name: board-haze.svg
assets.purpose: Drawn eraser ghost on the chalkboard surface.

assets.name: whiteboard-ghost.svg
assets.purpose: Drawn marker ghost on the whiteboard surface (5% opacity).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Chalk-white fill with board-green ink; one per client panel (Demo completa, Descargar RRQ, Siguiente). Marker black with white ink on the whiteboard.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7.5 5.2v13.6a.8.8 0 0 0 1.2.7l10.6-6.8a.8.8 0 0 0 0-1.4L8.7 4.5a.8.8 0 0 0-1.2.7z"/></svg>Demo completa</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(241,239,228,.24)); background: var(--raised, #20372c); color: var(--chalk, #f1efe4); font: 600 13.5px var(--sans, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: border-color .15s, background .15s, transform .05s; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #f1efe4); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, #f1efe4); border-color: var(--primary, #f1efe4); color: var(--primary-ink, #173327); }

components.name: Button
components.description: Raised frame with a 1px chalk-line border; a command mnemonic rides inside in caption mono.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(241,239,228,.24)); background: var(--raised, #20372c); color: var(--chalk, #f1efe4); font: 600 13.5px var(--sans, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: border-color .15s, background .15s, transform .05s; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: var(--chalk, #f1efe4); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #f1efe4); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mnemonic { font: 600 12px var(--mono, "Cascadia Code", Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace); color: var(--chalk-muted, #d3e2d6); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent toolbar action (Cancelar, Limpiar, En vivo); the on state is a chalk border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(241,239,228,.24)); background: transparent; color: var(--chalk, #f1efe4); font: 600 13.5px var(--sans, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost.is-on { border-color: var(--chalk, #f1efe4); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #f1efe4); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Protocol Tabs
components.description: A recessed well holding FTP and TFTP; the active tab is raised and underlined with the chalk stroke, the teacher underlining today's topic.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" role="tablist"><button class="ds-tab is-active" role="tab" aria-selected="true">FTP <small>TCP · 21</small></button><button class="ds-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false">TFTP <small>UDP · 69</small></button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--panel-2, #192c23); border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(241,239,228,.12)); } .ds-tab { position: relative; components.name: Text Input
components.description: Recessed monospace field: its value goes onto the wire. Focus turns the border chalk with a 3px halo.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" value="config-router.txt" aria-label="Archivo a descargar" spellcheck="false">
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--panel-2, #192c23); color: var(--chalk, #f1efe4); border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(241,239,228,.12)); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 9px; font: 13.5px var(--mono, "Cascadia Code", Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace); caret-color: var(--focus, #f1efe4); outline: none; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, rgba(241,239,228,.24)); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--focus, #f1efe4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #f1efe4) 22%, transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: .55; }

components.name: File Chip
components.description: Round mono action that fills the TFTP file name, with its size in faint chalk.
components.css: .ds-chip { border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(241,239,228,.24)); background: transparent; color: var(--chalk, #f1efe4); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 10px; font: 500 12px var(--mono, "Cascadia Code", Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .15s; } .ds-chip small { color: var(--chalk-faint, #a9c2b1); margin-left: 4px; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--chalk, #f1efe4); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #f1efe4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Connection state in a currentColor outline; neutral chalk tints only, never a protocol hue.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; font: 600 12px var(--sans, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid currentColor; color: var(--chalk-faint, #a9c2b1); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill.is-on { color: var(--chalk, #f1efe4); }

components.name: Chalked Packet Row
components.description: Signature: the packet as the teacher draws it. The stroke tile is masked over the role colour (--c), with a touch-down dot at the sender and a chevron head at the receiver; label above, TCP detail below, note beneath. Shown here with the plaintext password circled.
components.html:
+0.456 s
PASS redes2026
TCP · PSH, ACK · 16 B · 55208 → 21

El cliente manda la contraseña en texto plano.

components.description: ERROR and retransmission strokes switch to the dash tile and keep a 2px underline in their role colour until the board is erased.

narrative.overview:
The panel is the chalkboard of an anime classroom: a deep green board, framed by a darker green-black wall and side panels, on which every captured packet is chalked from sender to receiver as it crosses the wire. The class reads the protocol the way a teacher draws it: three lifelines, a lesson title underlined in chalk, one stroke per packet and a handwritten note beneath it. The system refuses both the dark Wireshark-style terminal dashboard and the white SaaS dashboard.

Density is split by audience. The board is set at projector scale for the back row; the side columns and the toolbar are set at laptop scale for the presenter who drives them. Colour is quarantined to protocol data, so a sky stroke always means a command and an orange one always means a retransmission, while the chrome stays in chalk white, worn chalk and board greens. Everything that looks drawn was drawn: the chalk stroke, dash, arrowhead, touch-down dot, circle, eraser and board haze are authored SVGs, never generated noise.

A whiteboard variant serves projectors that wash the green out. It keeps every role and every gesture, swaps chalk for flat marker lines, and keeps the board as the only bright plane in the room.
keyCharacteristics: A deep green board is the lit stage; the wall and side panels sit darker so the eye lands on the board.
Hue lives only in protocol data; chrome is chalk white, worn chalk and board greens.
Three hands: teacher's handwriting for notes and titles, monospace for anything that crossed the wire, system sans for controls.
Every chalk mark is an authored SVG used as a mask over the role colour; no procedural texture.
Motion is two gestures: a packet is chalked from sender to receiver, and Limpiar sweeps an eraser across the board.
Two variants, chalkboard and whiteboard, share one set of roles through `:root` and `:root[data-theme="light"]`.

rules.name: The Colour Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Hue belongs to protocol data. Buttons, pills, tabs, focus rings, log dots and panel chrome use only chalk white, worn chalk and the board greens. Chalk pink is the single exception, and only where chrome reports a failure.

rules.name: The Fixed Roles Rule
rules.body: A role keeps its colour everywhere it appears: sky for commands and requests, yellow for data, white for TCP handshake and close, faint for ACK, pink for failures, orange for retransmission. The whiteboard maps them one to one onto blue, green, black, grey, red and orange markers.

rules.name: The Spare Chalk Rule
rules.body: Inspector layer hues come from the chalks the board never uses, so a byte's layer can never be mistaken for a packet's role.

rules.name: The Tinted Wear Rule
rules.body: Worn chalk on the chalkboard is tinted with the board green, never a neutral grey. Every secondary text tint holds 4.5:1 on its own ground in both variants.

rules.name: The Three Hands Rule
rules.body: Klee One is the teacher writing on the board; monospace is anything that crossed the wire (labels, addresses, timestamps, hex, figures, file names, input values); system sans is the controls. A wire value is never set in Klee One, and a control is never set in it either.

rules.name: The Two Scales Rule
rules.body: Controls use the laptop scale (`--fs-caption` 12px to `--fs-display` 21px); the board uses the projector scale (`--fs-wire-meta`, `--fs-wire-label`, `--fs-wire-note`, `--fs-lesson`). Anything the class must read lives on the projector scale.

rules.name: The Still Figures Rule
rules.body: The whole page runs `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, and fixed columns hold times, sizes and statistics, so no figure moves sideways as its value changes.

rules.name: The Measured Silence Rule
rules.body: A retransmission's wait is drawn as its own gap row, 28px plus 16px per second of silence (capped at 6 s), labelled in orange handwriting. On this board, time is distance.

rules.name: The Lit Board Rule
rules.body: The board is always the brightest-reading plane in its variant. A new surface steps in tone, never in shadow.

rules.name: The Physical Object Rule
rules.body: Only things that physically float above the board cast a shadow: the eraser and the toast. Panels, cards and buttons stay flat.

rules.name: The Hand-Drawn Mark Rule
rules.body: A new mark reuses an authored mask with `background: var(--c)`: the colour comes from the role, the shape from the drawing. No procedural noise, no SVG turbulence and no gradient grain.

dos: **Do** give every new protocol element a role from the fixed set and set `--c` on it; the stroke, label, selection wash, legend swatch and badge all read from `--c`.

**Do** draw new chalk marks with the authored masks (`--stroke`, `--stroke-dash`, `--stroke-head`, `--stroke-dot`, the chalk circle) and give them a flat marker-bar fallback under `:root[data-theme="light"]`.
**Do** define every new colour in both `:root` and `:root[data-theme="light"]`, and hold secondary text at 4.5:1 on its own ground in both.
**Do** set anything the class must read on the projector scale (`--fs-wire-*`, `--fs-lesson`), and keep laptop-scale type for the presenter's controls.
**Do** keep failures dashed and underlined in their role colour until Limpiar erases the board.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: the chalk draw, the eraser and every transition switch off, and Limpiar clears instantly.
donts: **Don't** put a protocol hue on chrome: no coloured buttons, tabs, pills or focus rings. Pink is the only borrowed hue, and only to report a failure.
**Don't** reuse a protocol hue for an inspector layer, or a layer hue on the board.
**Don't** tint worn chalk on the chalkboard with a neutral grey; wear takes the board green.
**Don't** fake chalk with procedural noise, SVG turbulence or gradient grain; the strokes, haze and ghost are drawn.
**Don't** give panels, cards or buttons a drop shadow; only the eraser and the toast cast one.
**Don't** let a figure column change width as its value changes; times, sizes and statistics stay tabular.
**Don't** drift toward the dark Wireshark-style terminal dashboard or the white SaaS dashboard.
